name: UI colors
notes: Shared colors for text, menus, the HUD and UI icons, in the spirit of Hallownest's black-and-white interface. 1 = contour / text shadow, 2 = white text, 3 = black box paper, 4 = silver (box borders, ornaments), 5-7 = greys (dark to darkest: empty masks, bar back), 8 = brown, 9 = tan, 10 = orange Glare, 11 = moth violet, 12 = cream, 13 = slate, 14 = soul blue, 15 = soul white (the soul bar).
